entities.summary: Trent Nelson Taylor is an American professional football wide receiver for the San Francisco 49ers of the National Football League (NFL). He played college football for the Louisiana Tech Bulldogs and was selected by the 49ers in the fifth round of the 2017 NFL draft. Taylor also played for the Cincinnati Bengals and Chicago Bears.
